sections.heading: Patrick Tech Media take
sections.body: However, an IP48 rating doesn’t actually mean that a phone can withstand dust. All it means is that it’s protected against objects 1mm in size or larger — and dust is much smaller than that. Basically, Samsung is saying that the phones are protected against bits of wire and small pebbles. The next step is to see whether the current signals harden into a durable change or fade as a short-lived experiment.
